metadata.name: ResponsiveDesign
metadata.description: Essay: how the `responsive` block flips attribute values per size class or window width so the same Layout JSON adapts to phones, tablets, split-screen, and landscape. Nine H2 sections: the problem, the seven size-class keys, the block itself, single-winner resolution, window-width conditions (`minWidth:N` / `maxWidth:N`), generated-mode emission, dynamic-mode tree resolution, variant files, and when to choose `responsive` vs `platform` vs variant files. ~7-min read.

methods.name: onAppear
methods.description: Seed nextReadLinks from the module-scope NEXT_READ_ENTRIES catalog (two rows: next_one_layout_json -> /concepts/one-layout-json, next_hot_reload -> /concepts/hot-reload). Each row's titleKey / descriptionKey is resolved through StringManager with the concepts_responsive_design_ namespace prefix.

methods.name: onNavigate
methods.description: Client-side navigation via router.push(url). Destinations are the spec-mapped concept URLs enumerated in transitions: /concepts, /concepts/one-layout-json, /concepts/hot-reload.

vars.name: nextReadLinks
vars.description: Two closing 'read next' cards pointing at /concepts/one-layout-json and /concepts/hot-reload. Seeded by onAppear from the NEXT_READ_ENTRIES static catalog.

transitions.condition: url is a spec-mapped concept URL or /concepts

relatedFiles.description: Same shape as HotReloadViewModel — seeds nextReadLinks.

notes: Sixth concepts essay. Adds responsive-design between hot-reload and the natural follow-ups (one-layout-json revisits the multi-platform story; hot-reload shows how size-class changes get picked up at runtime).

Focus on the *mechanism* of size-class resolution, not on Tailwind-specific UI tricks. The reader should leave understanding when to use `responsive`, when `platforms` is enough, and when neither fits and a layout-file split is the right answer.
Pairs with /reference/attributes/responsive — the reference page documents the attribute shape, this concept page documents the runtime behavior.
